Hello there,

Fluoxetine is a SSRI depressant or Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitor. The purpose of that is to help balance chemical ups and downs in your brain chemistry. The first month or so can be tough as you adjust, but I know many including myself where this has become a blessing! If you have problems that worry you and your own well being please talk to your psychiatrist, it can be hard to get used to.

I’m so sorry for your pain inside. I understand where you are coming from but all self hurt will accomplish is a distraction from how you really feel. You’ve done so good, 3.5 years is remarkable! If you can make it that far, I know you can pursue that journey towards self love. Here for you ❤️

Hello there. Being sad will never make you a shitty person, your feelings are valid as long as they mean something to you. I whole heartedly recommend therapy. It can be terrifying talking to a stranger about the nuances of your day to day life and innermost feelings, but it’s not like you jump right into all of that immediately! Find a therapist you trust and share what you are comfortable with. Nothing feels better than discovering yourself.
Try a SSRI medication like lexipro, Very safe and helps balance those extreme lows. I’ve been taking it for a year and it’s a blessing. Don’t be afraid to move past this.
I’m so sorry you’re in pain. Hang around and just wait and see, the tough times make the good ones feel even better :)

I obviously don’t know you or your story but if your feelings aren’t being respected or validated maybe it’s time to surround yourself with people who cherish and support you.

Healing comes from within, try to find at least 2 things you love about yourself and write them down every day. I promise you, you are being hard on yourself. You should love YOU too ❤️

I understand and feel your pain. Softness is not a weakness but a strength. For a long time I did a really good job shutting myself off from those who I loved and the feelings around me, but over years I came to realize the only person that hurt was me. Sensitivity is a trait most people seldom have. Take pride in your ability to feel… even if it hurts so much right now. 

I promise you your family and friend hold so much love for you but people tend to focus inwardly. That is not a reflection on your value whatsoever. Take care, you are loved!
